## PART 5: DOCUMENTATION & FILING  
### Required Documentation  
For each risk assessment, keep on file:
- [ ] Original risk assessment form (signed)
- [ ] Supporting evidence (test results, incident logs)
- [ ] Control evaluation documentation
- [ ] Mitigation action plan
- [ ] Approval signatures
- [ ] Implementation tracking
name: Chunk 12/17

raw_entities.name: Documentation Completeness for Risk Assessments
raw_entities.description: A control requirement mandating that risk assessments maintain comprehensive documentation on file, including signed forms, supporting evidence, control evaluations, mitigation plans, approvals, and implementation tracking. This represents a procedural strength in governance documentation practices.
context: For each risk assessment, keep on file:

raw_entities.name: Risk Assessment Form Signature Control
raw_entities.description: A documented control requiring that original risk assessment forms be signed and retained on file as evidence of formal authorization and accountability for risk assessments.

raw_entities.description: A procedural requirement to file control evaluation documentation alongside risk assessments, enabling ongoing verification of control design and operating effectiveness.
